scenes.frame1: medium shot of a dirty greasy air fryer basket with burnt paper foil smoking slightly, dim moody kitchen lighting
scenes.frame2: low-angle shot of the frustrated PVC cook waving both hands in despair beside the messy air fryer

cuts.prompt: Rapid push-in zoom toward the smoking burnt foil and sticky residue
Snap cut to the cook looking up at the greasy basket, micro-camera shake
Snappy whip-pan pull-back revealing the whole smoky messy countertop

beats: 기름때는 안 지워지고 코팅은 다 벗겨져서
비싼 기계 통째로 버릴 뻔한 적
scenes.frame1: top-down view of peeled non-stick coating flakes and a harsh metallic sponge scrubbing the basket surface
scenes.frame2: 45-degree view of a worn-out cooking basket covered in scratch marks under harsh kitchen side lighting

cuts.prompt: Fast tracking over the flaking coating as the metal sponge scrapes across it
Hard cut to the scratched basket with dust particles floating in the harsh side light
Slow zoom-out revealing the cluttered messy kitchen counter with grease stains

scenes.frame1: front hero shot of the pastel sage-green silicone pot dropping gracefully into the center of the clean air fryer basket, studio spotlight
scenes.frame2: medium close-up of the grooved wave bottom ridges of the silicone pot with wide negative space around it

cuts.prompt: Smooth push-in as the pot lands softly in the middle of the frame with a gentle bounce
Hard cut to a circular camera orbit around the pot showcasing its grooved bottom ridges
Snap focus on the flexible soft silicone bending smoothly without deformation, then fast pull-back

scenes.frame1: high-angle shot showing the center divider separating sizzling crispy pork belly on one side and golden french fries on the other
scenes.frame2: medium close-up of hot golden oil draining cleanly down the radial wave grooves away from the food

cuts.prompt: Slow tracking glide across both sides of the divider as the food sizzles
Hard cut to slow-motion golden oil draining down the wave grooves with fluid ripples
Snappy whip-pan to an eye-level shot of delicate steam rising from the golden cooked meal

beats: 다 먹고 뒤집어서 물로 깨끗이 헹구면
scenes.frame1: medium shot of the PVC cook flipping the flexible silicone pot inside-out with an effortless snap, pristine clean surface
scenes.frame2: medium close-up of a crystal clear water stream splashing over the non-stick surface while oil slides off

cuts.prompt: Fast tracking as the hands flip the pot inside-out with a springy snap
Hard cut to a high-speed water stream splashing across the surface, oil sliding off in one second
Snappy whip-pan to the sparkling clean pot drying on a wooden miniature rack with a gleam effect

beats: 제품 정보는 하단 쇼핑 태그와 고정 댓글 확인!
scenes.frame1: wide beauty shot of neatly stacked sage green, cream and blush pink silicone pots on a modern clean kitchen island, empty space in the lower area
scenes.frame2: medium shot of a miniature wooden pointing arrow indicating downward toward the lower safe area

cuts.prompt: Smooth push-in on the stacked colorful pots with a shimmering clean kitchen background
Hard cut to the wooden arrow bouncing and pointing downward with a playful motion
Snappy whip-pan pull-back to a centered wide beauty shot of the whole product set, then hard blackout
